# Renderer libraries, kept for the renderer's home

These are the 94 outside Rust libraries that rust_crate/Cargo.lock lists for the renderer (bin/ws_renderer),
downloaded unchanged with `cargo vendor --locked vendor` on 2026-11-25. With rust_crate/.cargo/config.toml beside
them, cargo builds from this folder and needs no download.

Josie asked for them to be kept, packaged, until the survey decides which renderer PubCast uses. The renderer was
not built. This is on its own branch so the studio line does not carry the 80 MB.
